title: 3GPP TR 37.885 V2X path-loss constants and shadowing parameters
scope: Reference constants for the Phase-2 geometric radio model. No Phase-0 dataset carries an RSSI/path-loss observable, so nothing here is scored yet -- these entries exist so the Phase-2 implementation and its unit tests grade against ONE audited copy of the constants.
curated_from: docs/realism/ROADMAP.md section 3.2 item 1 (transcribed from 3GPP TR 37.885) and the Phase-2 benchmark gate 'implemented 37.885 formulas match published constants to 0.01 dB at d=100/500 m'.

urban_los.source: 3GPP TR 37.885, 'Study on evaluation methodology of new Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) use cases for LTE and NR', V2V channel models. Constants as transcribed in docs/realism/ROADMAP.md section 3.2 item 1: Urban LOS = 38.77 + 16.7*log10(d) + 18.2*log10(fc).
urban_los.note: d in metres, fc in GHz.

urban_nlos.source: Same 3GPP TR 37.885 V2V channel-model transcription as urban_los (via docs/realism/ROADMAP.md section 3.2 item 1): Urban NLOS = 36.85 + 30*log10(d) + 18.9*log10(fc).
urban_nlos.note: d in metres, fc in GHz.

highway_los.source: Same 3GPP TR 37.885 V2V channel-model transcription as urban_los (via docs/realism/ROADMAP.md section 3.2 item 1): Highway LOS = 32.4 + 20*log10(d) + 20*log10(fc).
highway_los.note: d in metres, fc in GHz. This is the free-space form.

nlosv_extra_loss_db.source: NLOSv (vehicle-blocked) additional loss modelled as max(0, N(mu, sigma)) with mu = 5..9 + max(0, 15*log10(d) - 41), per docs/realism/ROADMAP.md section 3.2 item 1.
nlosv_extra_loss_db.note: The mu base (5/9 dB) selects on blocker height class in TR 37.885; the ROADMAP records the range, so no single value is asserted here.

shadowing_sigma_db.cite: 3GPP TR 37.885 shadowing std. dev. (via ROADMAP section 3.2 item 3)
shadowing_sigma_db.source: Log-normal shadowing standard deviation sigma = 3 dB (LOS) / 4 dB (NLOS), adopted in docs/realism/ROADMAP.md section 3.2 item 3 together with a Gudmundson AR(1) correlation process.
shadowing_sigma_db.note: The decorrelation distance for the AR(1) process is in v2x_awareness.shadowing_decorrelation_distance_m.

nakagami_m_by_distance.source: Per-packet Nakagami-m fading with m = 3 / 1.5 / 1.0 over 0-50 / 50-150 / >150 m, adopted in docs/realism/ROADMAP.md section 3.2 item 4 (the standard VANET Nakagami parameterisation used by Veins/NS-3 802.11p studies).
nakagami_m_by_distance.note: A null upper bound means 'beyond the previous bound'.

pathloss_conformance_tolerance_db.source: docs/realism/ROADMAP.md Phase-2 benchmark gate: 'Pathloss unit test: implemented 37.885 formulas match published constants to 0.01 dB at d=100/500 m'.

reference_frequency_ghz.source: The ITS-G5 / DSRC control channel sits in the 5.9 GHz band; TR 37.885's fc term is evaluated in GHz.
reference_frequency_ghz.note: Used as the default fc when evaluating the formulas above.
